items.title: Brushed cotton flannel shirt, red check

listing.text: Size and delivery questions for the brushed cotton flannel shirt. How does this shirt fit? It is a regular fit with a straight hem, roomy through the shoulders and a little shorter than a dress shirt, so it sits well untucked. How do I measure my chest? Stand relaxed, wrap a soft tape around the fullest part of your chest just under the arms, keep it level across your back and read the figure without pulling tight. Which size should I pick? Size S suits a chest of 88 to 93 cm, M suits 94 to 99 cm, L suits 100 to 105 cm, XL suits 106 to 112 cm and XXL suits 113 to 119 cm. What are the garment measurements? Laid flat and measured from armpit to armpit, S is 54 cm across, M is 57 cm, L is 60 cm, XL is 63 cm and XXL is 66 cm. Back length from the top of the shoulder runs from 72 cm on the smallest size to 80 cm on the largest. How long are the sleeves? We measure from the shoulder seam to the edge of the cuff. The S sleeve is 61 cm and each size up adds roughly one centimetre. Two buttons on each cuff let you tighten it if your arms are on the short side. I am between two sizes, which one is better? Go down for a close fit under a jacket, and go up if you plan to wear a hoodie or a thermal top underneath. Will it shrink? The fabric is brushed and pre-washed before cutting, so expect no more than two or three percent change if you follow the care label and skip hot tumble drying. Is the fit the same for every colour? It is: every check and every solid colour is cut from one pattern at the same mill, so a medium in red check fits like a medium in navy. Who is wearing it in the photos? The first model is 178 cm tall with a 96 cm chest and wears size M. The second model is 165 cm tall and wears size S with the sleeves rolled twice. When will my order leave the warehouse? Orders placed before two in the afternoon on a working day are packed that same day. Later orders, and anything placed at the weekend or on a public holiday, are packed on the next working day. Where do you deliver? We cover every district of Hong Kong, the outlying islands included, and most addresses in Macau. Some remote island addresses need one extra day. How long does standard delivery take? Most urban addresses get the parcel two to three working days after dispatch. Island and Macau addresses usually take three to five working days. Is there an express service? Order before noon and express reaches Kowloon and Hong Kong Island the next working day. Its price appears at checkout before you confirm. Can I collect from a locker or a pickup point? Choose a self-collection point at checkout. The parcel waits there for seven days and you get a message when it arrives. How will I know where my parcel is? A tracking link goes out as soon as the label is printed. It updates when the parcel is scanned at the sorting hub, loaded onto the van and handed over. What if nobody is home? The driver leaves a card and tries again on the next working day. After two missed attempts the parcel moves to the nearest collection point and is kept there for a week. Can I change the address after ordering? Write to us before the parcel is packed and we can still edit it. Once a tracking link has been issued, the address is locked. How is the shirt packed? Each one is folded around a card insert, slipped into a paper sleeve and posted in a recycled mailer bag, with no plastic clips or tissue. Can I send it as a gift to another address? Enter the recipient's address, tick the gift box and we leave the price off the packing slip. Do parcels move on public holidays? Most couriers rest on public holidays, so anything sent just before a long weekend can arrive a day or two later than usual. Payment by bank transfer to a personal account in the owner's name only, with the details sent by chat after you message us. No returns, no refunds and no exchanges on any order.
